title: tesso config
description: Configuration for the tesso CLI. Tokens live in the CSS file named by outFile. The starter set is 19 plain names (--background, --foreground, --card, --card-foreground, --popover, --popover-foreground, --primary, --primary-foreground, --secondary, --secondary-foreground, --muted, --muted-foreground, --accent, --accent-foreground, --destructive, --border, --input, --ring, --radius) as raw oklch on :root and .dark. Requires Fusor 0.1.7 or newer.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL or path. The CLI writes ./node_modules/tesso-ui/schema.json.

outFile.description: CSS file the project owns. tesso init writes it once. tesso check reads it.

prefix.description: Optional CSS variable prefix without leading dashes. Empty emits plain names such as --background. A custom prefix emits --brand-background.

registry.description: Registry base URL or a local folder of component JSON. Omit it to use https://tesso.fyi/r/.
